integrity.source_date_note: The cohort anchor is the first public arXiv submission of Siniora--Solecki on 2017-05-04; the older Kechris--Rosendal automatic-continuity theorem is used as a supporting ingredient.
integrity.verification: The deduction was checked directly against the published source statements; no independent audit has been performed.

scientific_limitations: The result is a short synthesis of two known ingredients and may be folklore.
Nonseparable torsion-free targets are not covered.
For targets with torsion, only dense local finiteness of the image closure is forced; the image closure is not classified.
title: Separable images of free homogeneous automorphism groups inherit dense local finiteness
